parts.text:
use the image in this https://x.com/Maercihh/status/2078729226820424157 and create a video in the same style.

3 segments, all seamlessly blended one after the other, walking into and out of the other video.

do it for Seoul, San Francisco and Toronto

I pulled the reference art from the post and planned a three-part journey in that watercolor-and-ink style — one traveler walking through Seoul, San Francisco, and Toronto.

Here's how it came together:
* **Planned the scene** below — one traveler, three cities, with location references for Dongdaemun Design Plaza in Seoul, a steep San Francisco hillside, and an autumn street in Toronto.
* **Generated the three segments** and laid them on the timeline in order.
* **Blended them seamlessly** with 1-second crosszoom transitions, so she walks out of one city straight into the next.
* **Set a music bed** under the whole cut, with the clips muted so the score carries the journey.

Press play to watch it — then ask me to change anything: swap in your own city, adjust the pacing, add a title, or restyle the whole thing.
